sentences.text: Yang Yuanqing, born 12 November 1964 in Hefei, Anhui, China, earned a degree from Shanghai Jiao Tong University and a master's in computer science from the University of Science and Technology of China.

sentences.quote: In 1989, he joined Lenovo as a project manager in the Sun Workstation Division. In 1991, he became general manager of the Lenovo Group CAD Department. In 1994, he took charge of the Lenovo Computer Division.
sentences.text: He joined Lenovo in 1989 as a project manager in its Sun Workstation Division, took charge of the computer division in 1994, and became president and chief executive officer of Lenovo Group in 2001.

sentences.quote: Mr. Yang assumed the duties of Chief Executive Officer of the Company on February 5, 2009. Prior to that, he was the chairman of the Board from April 30, 2005. Before taking up the office as chairman, Mr. Yang was the chief executive officer and has been an executive director of the Company since December 16, 1997.
sentences.text: He is now chairman of the board, chief executive officer and an executive director of the company, having been an executive director since December 1997, chairman from April 2005, and resuming the CEO role on 5 February 2009.
As CEO he oversaw acquisitions including IBM's personal computer business and later the IBM x86 server and Motorola Mobility businesses.

mgmt_bio.text: He joined Lenovo in 1989 as a project manager in its Sun Workstation Division, took charge of the computer division in 1994, and became president and chief executive officer of Lenovo Group in 2001. He is now chairman of the board, chief executive officer and an executive director of the company, having been an executive director since December 1997, chairman from April 2005, and resuming the CEO role on 5 February 2009.

sentences.text: Yang Yuanqing remains chairman and chief executive.

In October 2026 Lenovo named Diego Majdalani senior vice president and president for Latin America, effective 12 October, succeeding Sergio Buniac, who became a vice president and general manager at Qualcomm.

Earlier moves included Tareq Alangari as senior vice president and president for Middle East, Turkiye and Africa in January 2026, Sumir Bhatia as the first Asia Pacific chief commercial officer in April, ahead of regional COO Ivan Cheung's June retirement, and global CIO Arthur Hu's departure to BD.

sentences.quote: Global PC market share reached a fourth quarter high at 24.4%, retaining the #1 position
sentences.text: Lenovo Group holds the number one position in global PCs, with fourth-quarter FY25/26 share of 24.4% and shipment growth outpacing the market by nearly six percentage points and the only top-five vendor with 10 consecutive quarters of positive year-on-year shipment growth.
AI is the main growth engine, with AI-related revenue up 105% in FY25/26 to 33% of group revenue, and AI PC penetration at 33% of Lenovo PC shipments for the year.

thesis_pillars.text: Lenovo Group holds the number one position in global PCs, with fourth-quarter FY25/26 share of 24.4% and shipment growth outpacing the market by nearly six percentage points and the only top-five vendor with 10 consecutive quarters of positive year-on-year shipment growth. The Infrastructure Solutions Group nearly doubled revenue to 8.5 billion dollars in the June 2026 quarter at a 9.1% operating margin, with an AI server pipeline of 54 billion dollars. The Solutions and Services Group grew 19% in Q4 with margins above 20% and a record 62% of revenue from managed services and projects. Adjusted profit rose 176% to 1.075 billion dollars in the June 2026 quarter.
